display_long_description:
Welcome to Puzzling Pieces – The Ultimate 3D VR Spatial Jigsaw Adventure!

Unwind and challenge your mind with Puzzling Pieces, an immersive VR puzzle game where you bring vibrant 3D miniature worlds to life! Move beyond flat 2D puzzles—grab, rotate, and snap detailed low-poly environmental pieces together in a full 360-degree VR space.

Whether you want a quick relaxing break or a brain-teasing challenge, Puzzling Pieces offers the perfect spatial puzzle experience for players of all skill levels.

🌟 Key Features:

3D Spatial Gameplay: Grab, rotate, and snap 3D environment pieces in full VR.

Beautiful Low-Poly Lands: Rebuild ancient ruins, tropical forests, and natural landscapes.

Intuitive Motion Controls: Smoothly pick up and snap pieces using your Quest controllers.

Multiple Difficulties & Best Times: Choose your mode and challenge your best completion times.

Relaxing & Mindful: Stress-free, immersive gameplay designed for pure relaxation.

🎮 How to Play:

Select a Land and choose your difficulty (Easy, Medium, or Hard).

Use your controller triggers to grab scattered 3D pieces.

Match and snap each piece onto the floating grid to complete the diorama!

Put on your headset and start rebuilding 3D worlds in VR today!
